'''Radar''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]. It could be installed into a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] chassis;<ref name="RPG" /> [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droids]] included radar transceivers in their [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]].<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> Radar worked by emitting pulses of energy and then examining the way the energy was reflected back at the sensor.<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|In ''Star Wars'', ships don't have radar; they have sensors.|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game''|<ref name="RPG" />}}
The [[1987]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|first edition]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' published by [[West End Games]] claims that the term "sensors" should always be used over "radar" in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' setting.<ref name="RPG" /> Nevertheless, later sources, including those published by West End, continued to make use of both terms.<ref name="SWS" />
